description: This file contains unit tests for the functions related to building and analyzing execution DAGs (Directed Acyclic Graphs) of workflow executions within the handler package, including functions for constructing DAGs, deriving statuses, and converting execution data to DAG nodes.

methods.name: TestBuildExecutionDAG_Simple
methods.description: Tests building a simple execution DAG with a single execution.

methods.name: TestBuildExecutionDAG_WithParentChild
methods.description: Tests building a DAG with parent-child relationships between executions.

methods.name: TestBuildExecutionDAG_MultipleChildren
methods.description: Tests DAG building with multiple children for a parent execution.

methods.name: TestBuildExecutionDAG_DeepHierarchy
methods.description: Tests building a hierarchical DAG with multiple levels.

methods.name: TestBuildExecutionDAG_EmptyExecutions
methods.description: Tests the behavior when input executions list is empty.

methods.name: TestBuildExecutionDAG_NilExecutions
methods.description: Confirms handling of nil or empty execution slices.

methods.name: TestDeriveOverallStatus_AllSucceeded
methods.description: Verifies that overall status derives as 'succeeded' when all executions succeed.

methods.name: TestDeriveOverallStatus_OneFailed
methods.description: Verifies that overall status is 'failed' if any execution has failed.

methods.name: TestDeriveOverallStatus_OneRunning
methods.description: Verifies that overall status is 'running' if any execution is running.

methods.name: TestDeriveOverallStatus_Pending
methods.description: Checks that statuses like 'pending' or 'queued' lead to an overall 'running' status.

methods.name: TestBuildLightweightExecutionDAG_Simple
methods.description: Tests building a lightweight execution DAG with a single execution.

methods.name: TestBuildLightweightExecutionDAG_WithParentChild
methods.description: Tests lightweight DAG construction with parent-child relationships.

methods.name: TestBuildLightweightExecutionDAG_EmptyExecutions
methods.description: Tests scenario with an empty list of executions for lightweight DAG.

methods.name: TestBuildExecutionDAG_ComplexHierarchy
methods.description: Tests hierarchical DAG with multiple levels and branches.

methods.name: TestBuildExecutionDAG_MixedStatuses
methods.description: Checks correct status derivation with mixed execution statuses.

methods.name: TestBuildExecutionDAG_OrphanedChild
methods.description: Tests handling of orphaned children whose parent isn't in the execution list.

methods.name: TestBuildExecutionDAG_CycleDetection
methods.description: Verifies robustness against circular parent-child references.

methods.name: TestBuildExecutionDAG_WithSessionAndActor
methods.description: Tests extraction of session and actor IDs from executions.

methods.name: TestDeriveOverallStatus_PriorityOrder
methods.description: Ensures status priority order (running > failed > succeeded) is respected.

methods.name: TestBuildLightweightExecutionDAG_ComplexHierarchy
methods.description: Verifies depth calculation and hierarchy in a complex lightweight DAG.

methods.name: TestExecutionToDAGNode
methods.description: Tests conversion of an Execution object to a DAG node structure.

methods.name: TestExecutionToLightweightNode
methods.description: Tests conversion of an Execution object to a lightweight node.

methods.name: TestIsLightweightRequest
methods.description: Placeholder or conceptual test for identifying lightweight request queries.

methods.name: TestNewExecutionGraphService
methods.description: Tests creation and initialization of the execution graph service with storage provider.

methods.name: setupTestStorage
methods.description: Helper for setting up local storage for tests, handles configuration, error checking, and cleanup.

methods.name: executionToDAGNode
methods.description: Converts a full execution record into a DAG node with detailed info.

methods.name: executionToLightweightNode
methods.description: Converts a lightweight execution record into a concise node format.

methods.name: stringPtr
methods.description: Utility to create a string pointer from a string.
